description:
Use this when the user wants the documents an Indian company filed, grouped by type: results, annual reports, investor presentations, call transcripts and recordings, board meeting and AGM papers, ratings. For what was announced and when use get_stock_events.

List the documents an Indian listed company filed, grouped by type, each with its source link.

    Accepts NSE symbol, ISIN, or BSE code. `days` (1..1825, default 365) bounds the trailing window;
    `document_type` narrows to one type (results, annual_report, presentation, transcript, recording,
    board_meeting, agm_egm, insider_takeover, rating, ...; the response lists the types present).
    Each document has `type`, the exchange-group `filing_type`, `source_url`, `published_at` and a
    nullable `extraction_id` (pass it as `news_id` to get_filing_extract when facts are cached).
    Earnings-call transcripts and call recordings appear where the company posted them under SEBI
    LODR Regulation 30, labelled `statement_by: company`; they are links only, not transcribed or
    summarised. Filings with no attachment are counted in `without_source`.
    Cache-only.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_company_documents
title: Company documents by type
